GU_ZHEN_REN_PERSONAL_KEYWORD_UNIQUE.desc: Each player may keep only one copy of a card with this name in their permanent deck.
GU_ZHEN_REN_PERSONAL_KEYWORD_XIAN_GU.des: A Rank 6 or higher Gu. During this run, only one copy of the same Immortal Gu may exist across all players' permanent decks.
GU_ZHEN_REN_PERSONAL_KEYWORD_CUI_DONG.de: A Gu card must be used with an Activation card in hand.
GU_ZHEN_REN_PERSONAL_KEYWORD_HUI_FU.desc: After a Gu is activated, it enters the Gu Storage Pile after the listed number of turns.
GU_ZHEN_REN_PERSONAL_KEYWORD_KE_XUE.desc: Spend the listed amount of Blood Essence to use or empower the corresponding effect.
GU_ZHEN_REN_PERSONAL_KEYWORD_ZI_SHI.desc: When paying Bloodthirst, lose 2 HP for each missing Blood Essence instead; this cannot reduce HP below 1.
GU_ZHEN_REN_PERSONAL_KEYWORD_ZONG_E_DU.d: AoE damage, Bleed, or Blood Marks are shared totals divided among living enemies, not copied per enemy.
GU_ZHEN_REN_PERSONAL_KEYWORD_YI_CHU.desc: When a resource gain exceeds its cap, the amount that could not be gained is converted into another benefit as stated by the card.
GU_ZHEN_REN_PERSONAL_KEYWORD_ZHUI_JI.des: If the target dies, unresolved remaining hits move to another living enemy.
GU_ZHEN_REN_PERSONAL_KEYWORD_PO_SHI.desc: When an effect reduces an enemy that originally had Block to 0 Block, it is considered a Break Stance.
GU_ZHEN_REN_PERSONAL_KEYWORD_YAO_HUA1.de: When you have at least 1 Radiance, automatically spend 1 Radiance and trigger this card’s Illumination effect.
GU_ZHEN_REN_PERSONAL_KEYWORD_YAO_HUA2.de: When you have at least 2 Radiance, automatically spend 2 Radiance and trigger this card’s Illumination effect.
GU_ZHEN_REN_PERSONAL_KEYWORD_YAO_HUA3.de: When you have at least 3 Radiance, automatically spend 3 Radiance and trigger this card’s Illumination effect.
GU_ZHEN_REN_PERSONAL_KEYWORD_YAO_HUA4.de: When you have at least 4 Radiance, automatically spend 4 Radiance and trigger this card’s Illumination effect.
GU_ZHEN_REN_PERSONAL_KEYWORD_YAO_HUA5.de: When you have at least 5 Radiance, automatically spend 5 Radiance and trigger this card’s Illumination effect.
GU_ZHEN_REN_PERSONAL_KEYWORD_YAO_HUA6.de: When you have at least 6 Radiance, automatically spend 6 Radiance and trigger this card’s Illumination effect.
GU_ZHEN_REN_PERSONAL_KEYWORD_YAO_HUA7.de: When you have at least 7 Radiance, automatically spend 7 Radiance and trigger this card’s Illumination effect.
GU_ZHEN_REN_PERSONAL_KEYWORD_YAO_HUA8.de: When you have at least 8 Radiance, automatically spend 8 Radiance and trigger this card’s Illumination effect.
GU_ZHEN_REN_PERSONAL_KEYWORD_YAO_HUA9.de: When you have at least 9 Radiance, automatically spend 9 Radiance and trigger this card’s Illumination effect.
GU_ZHEN_REN_PERSONAL_KEYWORD_SHI_HAI1.de: Choose up to 1 Remains in your hand to consume or absorb; see this card's description for the effect. Remains are gained when a Blood Path Gu card kills an enemy, or when Bleed kills it; unused Remains are kept in your permanent deck after combat.
GU_ZHEN_REN_PERSONAL_KEYWORD_SHI_HAI2.de: Choose up to 2 Remains in your hand to consume or absorb; see this card's description for the effect. Remains are gained when a Blood Path Gu card kills an enemy, or when Bleed kills it; unused Remains are kept in your permanent deck after combat.
GU_ZHEN_REN_PERSONAL_KEYWORD_SHI_HAI3.de: Choose up to 3 Remains in your hand to consume or absorb; see this card's description for the effect. Remains are gained when a Blood Path Gu card kills an enemy, or when Bleed kills it; unused Remains are kept in your permanent deck after combat.
GU_ZHEN_REN_PERSONAL_KEYWORD_XU_YING.des: Remains in hand and cannot be played manually. After a non-Phantom Attack, the Strength controller checks manifestations in stable order. Phantoms do not trigger other Phantoms. Phantom Attack damage is affected by Strength.
GU_ZHEN_REN_PERSONAL_KEYWORD_LIAN_LI.des: Each beast-strength Gu permanently tracks its own 0/3 progress. The first effective activation on each different turn grants +1; duplicates, copies, and replays that turn do not. If training was complete when combat began, activation can create its phantom; progress completed during combat takes effect next combat.
GU_ZHEN_REN_PERSONAL_KEYWORD_NIAN_HUA.de: A Time Path resource. At 6, trigger Year Complete, reset to 0, and continue resolving overflow.
GU_ZHEN_REN_PERSONAL_KEYWORD_SUI_MAN.des: Choose a cooling-down Gu to reduce its cooldown by 1 turn; extend all duration-based enemy debuffs by 1 turn.
GU_ZHEN_REN_PERSONAL_KEYWORD_HUAN_BU.des: An enemy attack shares one fixed damage-reduction budget across all hits. It ticks down by turns and can be extended by Year Complete.
GU_ZHEN_REN_PERSONAL_KEYWORD_XI_YING.des: A temporary copy created by Backtrack Gu. It Exhausts, cannot be Backtracked again, and grants Years when played.
